lines.en: label beachvacation1:
scene bedroom_day
: What time is it?
lines.zh: : 几点了？

lines.en: I roll out of bed and clumsily reach for my phone on the end table and confirm that I've woken up significantly later than normal today.
lines.zh: 我从床上爬起来，笨手笨脚地去够床头柜上的手机，确认我今天醒得比平时晚了很多。

lines.en: It’s almost 10:00AM and I haven’t even gotten out of bed yet.
lines.zh: 快上午十点了，我居然还没下床。

lines.en: Normally, Ami would barge in and prevent me from sleeping in like this, but...I guess she has other things to do today?
lines.zh: 平时Ami早就冲进来不让我睡懒觉了，不过……她今天大概是另有安排？

lines.en: What gives?
lines.zh: 什么情况？

lines.en: I would have invested in an alarm clock if I knew my [niece] would be this unreliable.
lines.zh: 早知道我的[niece]这么靠不住，我就该买个闹钟的。

lines.en: That’s right. This is all her fault.
lines.zh: 没错。这一切都是她的错。

lines.en: I should go give her a piece of my mind.
lines.zh: 我得去好好说她一顿。

lines.en: scene lr_day
I walk out into the living room only to be met with another horrible reality.
lines.zh: 我走进客厅，迎面撞上又一个残酷的现实。

lines.en: Breakfast isn’t ready either.
lines.zh: 早饭也没做好。

lines.en: Is Ami dead?
lines.zh: Ami死了？

lines.en: That is the only possible thing I could think of given these circumstances.
lines.zh: 在这种情况下，这是我唯一能想到的事了。

lines.en: : Ami, are you dead?
lines.zh: : Ami，你死了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei is finally up!
lines.zh: : 啊，Sensei终于起床了！

lines.en: Oh. I guess Ayane is over.
lines.zh: 哦。看来Ayane来了。

lines.en: I mean, that at least kind of explains the lack of an alarm or breakfast...but I’m still not entirely convinced.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，这至少能解释为什么没有闹钟也没有早饭……但我还是不太信服。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come in and hang out with us!
lines.zh: : Sensei！进来陪我们一起呀！

lines.en: : What? Wait a second! Don’t you dare-
lines.zh: : 等等！你敢——

lines.en: I decide to do what any sane man would do and barge into my [niece]’s room despite her plea for privacy.
lines.zh: 我决定做一个正常男人都会做的事——无视我[niece]对隐私的请求，冲进她的房间。

lines.en: scene black
jump mayachangex
label mayachangex:
After all, Ayane said I could enter. So it’s not like I’m in the wrong or anything.
lines.zh: 毕竟Ayane都说了我可以进。所以我也没做错什么。

lines.en: I just need to confirm that Ami isn’t in trouble. She should be thanking me.
lines.zh: 我只是要确认Ami没出事。她该谢谢我才对。

lines.en: scene beachintro1
: Oh.
: Sensei! What the heck?! I was trying to tell you to not come in!
lines.zh: : Sensei！搞什么啊？！我刚才不是让你别进来吗！

lines.en: : But...Ayane said I could.
lines.zh: : 可是……Ayane说可以啊。

lines.en: : Of course I did! I wanted you to see my swimsuit! Super cute, right?
lines.zh: : 当然是我说的啦！我想让你看看我的泳衣！超可爱吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, you look great Ayane.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很好看，Ayane。

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Leave?
lines.zh: : 出去？

lines.en: : Morning, Maya.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Maya。

lines.en: scene beachintro2
: “Morning, Maya?” Are you kidding me right now?
lines.zh: : 「早上好，Maya」？你在跟我开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Um...Sensei...I don’t...think you should be looking at her when she’s changing...
lines.zh: : 那个……Sensei……我觉得……她换衣服的时候你不该看……

lines.en: : Morning, Sana.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sana。

lines.en: scene beachintro3
: Um...morning...
lines.zh: : 嗯……早上好……

lines.en: : See, Maya? Totally normal. Just a standard greeting exchanged between two people in the morning.
lines.zh: : 看吧，Maya？很正常啊。不过是早上两个人之间一句普通的问候罢了。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: scene beachintro4
: How long are you just gonna stand there for?! We’re trying to get changed!
lines.zh: : 你打算在那儿站到什么时候？！我们还要换衣服呢！

lines.en: : Are you? I didn’t notice.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我没注意到。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : You already said that.
lines.zh: : 这话你说过了。

lines.en: : Saying it once didn’t properly convey my feelings on the matter.
lines.zh: : 只说一次不足以表达我对这件事的感受。

lines.en: : Want to say it a third time just to make sure I know?
lines.zh: : 要不要说第三遍，好让我记住？

lines.en: : Yes. You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 好。你真恶心。

lines.en: scene beachintro5
: Well, umm...on the bright side...at least he didn’t see the two of us naked?
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……往好处想……至少他没看到我们两个光着身子？

lines.en: : That’s a plus...right?...
lines.zh: : 这也算好事……对吧？……

lines.en: : Hm? Are you that worried about being seen naked, Sana? I think you’ve got an adorable body!
lines.zh: : 嗯？Sana你就这么怕被人看到裸体吗？我觉得你的身材超可爱的！

lines.en: : Lots of guys are into that whole “I’m tiny and precious” sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 很多男生就吃「娇小又惹人怜爱」那一套。

lines.en: : Uhh...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢？

lines.en: scene beachintro6
: Sensei, can we get the ball rolling soon? I don’t know if I can wait any longer.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们能不能快点出发呀？我不知道还能不能再等下去了。

lines.en: : I’m going to need some clarification before I gravely misinterpret what you mean by that.
lines.zh: : 在我严重误解你的意思之前，我需要你解释一下。

lines.en: : She means the beach, dummy! You were supposed to take us there like an hour ago!
lines.zh: : 她说的是海滩，笨蛋！你不是应该一小时前就带我们去了吗！

lines.en: : But you’re not even dressed yet.
lines.zh: : 可你们连衣服都还没换好啊。

lines.en: scene beachintro7
: I KNOW THAT!
lines.zh: : 我知道啊！

lines.en: : We were ready but then got tired of waiting for you to wake up so we were showing each other our swimsuits!
lines.zh: : 我们本来都准备好了，可是等你起床等得不耐烦，就开始互相展示泳衣了！

lines.en: : Does Maya’s swimsuit not come with a top?
lines.zh: : Maya的泳衣是没有上衣款的吗？

lines.en: scene beachintro8
: Do you not come with a sense of decency?
lines.zh: : 你是没有廉耻之心吗？

lines.en: : I do not.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : You are disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ve mentioned that a few times now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话你已经说过好几次了。

lines.en: scene beachintro9
: Um...maybe it would be best if...Ayane and I talked with you outside the bedroom?
lines.zh: : 那个……要不……我和Ayane去外面跟你说话？

lines.en: : That way...Ami and Maya could finish getting changed and...not be stared at...
lines.zh: : 这样……Ami和Maya就能换完衣服……也不会被盯着看了……

lines.en: : Yes! What a great idea, Sana! Apparently Sensei needs a reason to not ogle at my friends’ naked bodies!
lines.zh: : 对！Sana这主意太好了！看来Sensei需要一个不去盯我朋友裸体的理由！

lines.en: : In my defense, no one here is completely naked.
lines.zh: : 我为自己辩解一句，这里可没人全裸。

lines.en: : I can’t even see Maya’s-
lines.zh: : 我连Maya的——

lines.en: : One more word and I’ll destroy everything you love.
lines.zh: : 你再多说一个字，我就毁掉你珍爱的一切。

lines.en: That’s worrying for several different reasons because I’m pretty sure she could do something like that.
lines.zh: 这句话让人担忧的理由有好几个，因为我很确定她真干得出来。

lines.en: I guess I’ve had my fun, though.
lines.zh: 不过我也玩够了。

lines.en: If we really are starting that vacation thing today, I’m sure I’ll be seeing plenty of mildly-exposed girls in the near future.
lines.zh: 如果今天真的要开始度假，那我肯定很快就能看到更多半遮半掩的女孩。

lines.en: I shouldn’t spoil all of that fun at once.
lines.zh: 我不该一次就把这点乐趣全挥霍掉。

lines.en: : Okay, just hurry up. We wouldn’t want to be late.
lines.zh: : 好了，快点吧。我们可不想迟到。

lines.en: scene beachintro10
: We’re already late!
lines.zh: : 我们已经迟到了！

lines.en: : Why are you like this?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么总是这样？！

lines.en: scene black
That’s a good question, Ami. Why am I like this?
lines.zh: 问得好啊，Ami。我为什么是这样的人？

lines.en: A better question, though, would be “Why is everyone in my life so cute?”
lines.zh: 不过更好的问题应该是「为什么我身边的人一个比一个可爱？」

lines.en: For real. Think about that for a second.
lines.zh: 真的。你仔细想想。

lines.en: Every single one of my students is adorable. Even their moms are attractive.
lines.zh: 我的每一个学生都很可爱。连她们的母亲都很有魅力。

lines.en: What did I do to deserve such a blessed life?
lines.zh: 我到底做了什么，配得上这么幸福的人生？

lines.en: scene whythesky
scene beachintro11
: Heya, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 嗨呀，Sensei！

lines.en: : Sorry to keep you waiting. We just had to change back into our normal clothes since we’d attract the prying eyes of so many strangers on the bus in our swimsuits.
lines.zh: : 让你久等了。我们得换回常服，因为穿着泳衣坐巴士会引来一大堆陌生人偷看。

lines.en: : Well...Ayane would...I don’t think many people would pay much attention to me.
lines.zh: : 那个……Ayane会吧……我觉得没多少人会在意我。

lines.en: scene beachintro12
: You’ve gotta stop putting yourself down like that, Sana. Confidence is the most attractive quality in a girl.
lines.zh: : Sana你别总这么贬低自己。自信是女孩最有魅力的品质。

lines.en: : You can be a 5/10 but as long as you act like a 10/10 people will get confused and be like “Woah, maybe I do wanna bone her.”
lines.zh: : 就算你只有五分，只要你表现得像十分，别人就会犯迷糊：「哇，说不定我真的很想上她。」

lines.en: scene beachintro13
: A five?! E-Even I thought I was higher than that...
lines.zh: : 五分？！我……我自己觉得还要高一点吧……

lines.en: scene beachintro14
: You are! You’re an 11/10! If I liked girls, I’d ask you to marry me. That’s how cute you are.
lines.zh: : 你当然更高！你是十一分！如果我喜欢女生，我都要向你求婚了。你就是这么可爱。

lines.en: scene beachintro15
: I’m so confused...
lines.zh: : 我好混乱……

lines.en: : That’s fine. The only opinion that really matters belongs to Sensei anyway. And I’m sure he thought you looked super pretty in your swimsuit. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正真正重要的只有Sensei的看法。而且我敢肯定，他觉得你穿泳衣超漂亮的。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: menu:
Of course
lines.zh: 当然

lines.en: : Absolutely. She was so cute that it should be illegal.
lines.zh: : 当然。她可爱到简直应该被判违法。

lines.en: scene beachintro16
: I-Illegal?! I don’t want to go to jail!
lines.zh: : 违……违法？！我不要坐牢！

lines.en: : I’m not even done with[school] yet!
lines.zh: : 我[school]都还没毕业呢！

lines.en: : See what I mean? Bump up that confidence a bit.
lines.zh: : 懂我意思了吧？自信再涨一点。

lines.en: scene beachintro17
: But also don’t get any cuter because I get really jealous whenever Sensei looks at other girls! Hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 不过也别变得更可爱了，因为Sensei一看别的女生我就吃醋！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Ah! Uhh...I’ll...try...not to?
lines.zh: : 啊！呃……我……尽量吧？

lines.en: Eh...
: Ehh...Developing a little more might be good for her...
lines.zh: : 呃……再发育一点可能对她有好处……

lines.en: scene beachintro18
: Mmn...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: : What the fuck is your problem?
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么毛病？

lines.en: : Sure, her boobs are tiny and she’s under 5 feet tall, but she has plenty to offer.
lines.zh: : 是，她胸是小了点，身高也不到五英尺，可她有的是别的好处。

lines.en: : I...can hear you, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我……听得到啊，Ayane……

lines.en: scene beachintro19
: It’s okay...Sensei...I know I’m not really the most...grown-up looking girl...
lines.zh: : 没关系……Sensei……我知道我看起来确实不太……成熟……

lines.en: : Someone like Ayane is much more...suited to your tastes...That’s okay...
lines.zh: : 像Ayane那样的人更……合你的口味……没关系的……

lines.en: : Yes. That may be true. But he should still acknowledge your cuteness, Sana.
lines.zh: : 是，也许是这样。但他还是该承认你很可爱啊，Sana。

lines.en: : This is a transgression that I simply can not overlook.
lines.zh: : 这是我绝不能视而不见的冒犯。

lines.en: : Or at least I will pretend to overlook it and then forget about it after a few minutes because I love him so much.
lines.zh: : 或者至少我会假装视而不见，然后过几分钟就忘了，因为我太爱他了。

lines.en: : This conversation is going places I really didn’t intend.
lines.zh: : 这对话的走向完全超出了我的本意。

lines.en: : Of course Sana’s cute. She’s just...you know. Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana当然可爱。她只是……你知道的。Sana。

lines.en: scene beachintro18
: My heart aches...
lines.zh: : 我心好痛……

lines.en: : Anyway, sorry to keep you guys waiting. Ami normally comes and wakes me up in the morning.
lines.zh: : 总之，抱歉让你们等了。平时都是Ami早上来叫我起床的。

lines.en: : Not sure why she just...didn’t do that today.
lines.zh: : 不知道她今天怎么就……没来。

lines.en: scene beachintro20
: She probably just got a little distracted when Sana and I showed up out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 大概是我和Sana突然出现，她有点分心了吧。

lines.en: : We planned on taking my father’s limo there but realized it might be a little more fun to go with everyone on the bus instead.
lines.zh: : 我们本来打算坐我爸的豪车去，后来觉得和大家一起坐巴士可能更有趣。

lines.en: : How would public transportation ever be more fun than a limo?
lines.zh: : 公共交通怎么可能比豪车更有趣？

lines.en: scene beachintro21
: Because you’d be there, of course! Duh!
lines.zh: : 因为你也在啊，当然啦！笨！

lines.en: : Yeah, but couldn’t you have just asked the limo to stop here and take us all instead?
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你不可以让豪车在这儿停一下，把我们一起带走吗？

lines.en: scene beachintro22
: Hey! Wanna go see how comfy Sensei’s couch is?
lines.zh: : 嘿！要不要去试试Sensei的沙发有多舒服？

lines.en: : Um...O-Okay?...
scene beachintro23
Ayane grabs Sana by the wrist and nearly throws her onto the couch.
lines.zh: Ayane一把抓住Sana的手腕，几乎是把她扔到了沙发上。

lines.en: Within a matter of seconds, I can hear Ami's and Maya’s voices nearing the bedroom door...
lines.zh: 几秒之内，我就听到Ami和Maya的声音朝卧室门口靠近……

lines.en: scene beachintro24
: You!
: Me.
: What do you think you’re doing barging into my room like that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己那样冲进我房间是干什么？

lines.en: : I barge into your room all the time.
lines.zh: : 我平时也老冲进你房间啊。

lines.en: : But today I had friends over! Naked friends!
lines.zh: : 可今天有朋友在！裸体的朋友！

lines.en: : Partially-naked. And, if anything, this is your fault for letting your friends get undressed in your room.
lines.zh: : 是半裸。而且要说的话，是你自己的错，谁让你让朋友在你房间里脱衣服。

lines.en: : We’re girls! That’s just a thing we do!
lines.zh: : 我们是女生啊！我们本来就这样的！

lines.en: I was born the wrong sex.
lines.zh: 我投错胎了。

lines.en: : Okay, whatever. I’m sorry. But what’s done is done.
lines.zh: : 好吧，算了。对不起。不过覆水难收。

lines.en: : What do you want me to do? Call off the vacation thing?
lines.zh: : 你想让我怎么办？取消度假？

lines.en: : You mean the vacation thing you forgot to wake up on time for?
lines.zh: : 你是说那个你忘了准时起床的度假？

lines.en: : Yeah, that one.
lines.zh: : 啊，那个。

lines.en: : Well...no! But you should at least apologize to Maya!
lines.zh: : 哼……不取消！但你至少该跟Maya道歉！

lines.en: : She’ll just call me disgusting again.
lines.zh: : 她又会骂我恶心。

lines.en: : Probably! But if you ever want to see me again, you’ll do the right thing and apologize!
lines.zh: : 大概会吧！但你要是还想见到我，就乖乖去做正确的事，道歉！

lines.en: : What, you’re going to run away now?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你现在要离家出走？

lines.en: : Maybe!
lines.zh: : 说不定！

lines.en: Ami seems adamant about me apologizing and Maya hasn’t even left the bedroom yet.
lines.zh: Ami似乎铁了心要我道歉，而Maya还没从卧室里出来。

lines.en: Maybe she’s more upset about this than I thought?
lines.zh: 也许她比我想的更生气？

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I’ll apologize.
lines.zh: : 好好好，我道歉。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Maya! You can come out now.
lines.zh: : Maya！你可以出来了。

lines.en: scene beachintro23
Ami goes to join Ayane and Sana on the couch and, within a matter of seconds, Maya emerges from the bedroom.
lines.zh: Ami去沙发上找Ayane和Sana，没过几秒，Maya从卧室里走了出来。

lines.en: scene beachintro25
: ...So about the barging in thing.
lines.zh: : ……那个，关于我冲进来的事。

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 关于什么？
: 我很……

lines.en: : Ecstatic? Thrilled? Aroused?
lines.zh: : 欣喜若狂？兴奋不已？欲火焚身？

lines.en: : All three, actually. But more than that, I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 其实是三个都有。不过更重要的是，我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene beachintro26
: No you’re not.
lines.zh: : 你才不抱歉。

lines.en: : Right now you’re thinking, “Omg. Cute girls. Boobies. Yay!” or something along those lines, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你现在心里想的是「天哪。可爱女孩。奶子。耶！」之类的吧？

lines.en: : ...Maybe.
lines.zh: : ……也许吧。

lines.en: scene beachintro27
: Ugh. Whatever. Just forget what you saw here.
lines.zh: : 啧。算了。把在这儿看到的忘掉。

lines.en: : I’m going to go talk to my friends now.
lines.zh: : 我要去找我朋友了。

lines.en: : Please don’t follow me.
lines.zh: : 别跟着我。

lines.en: scene beachintro23
Soon enough, I am the only person left standing in the living room as Maya, too, joins the rest of the girls on the couch.
lines.zh: 很快，客厅里就只剩我一个人——Maya也去沙发上和其他女孩坐到了一起。

lines.en: : I’m going to follow her.
lines.zh: : 我要跟过去。

lines.en: jump restofmayachange
label restofmayachange:
scene beachintro28
: What’s everybody else saying? Are they there yet?
lines.zh: : 其他人怎么说？她们到了吗？

lines.en: : Umm...Well, Molly sent me a picture of a hermit crab, so I’m pretty sure her and Rin are there.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Molly给我发了张寄居蟹的照片，所以我敢肯定她和Rin已经到了。

lines.en: : Futaba, I haven’t heard from. And I don’t have Makoto’s number saved because I want her head to explode.
lines.zh: : 二叶还没消息。Makoto的号码我没存，因为我想让她的头爆炸。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这很正常。

lines.en: scene beachintro29
: We’re gonna leave soon, right?
lines.zh: : 我们很快就要出发了吧？

lines.en: : It would be a waste to start our vacation off halfway through the day when we’re only going to be there for two nights.
lines.zh: : 我们只住两晚，要是度假从半天之后才开始就太浪费了。

lines.en: : I don’t even know where we’re staying yet.
lines.zh: : 我连我们住哪儿都不知道。

lines.en: scene beachintro30
: Makoto and I took care of that already. She reserved the place and I used my credit card to pay for it.
lines.zh: : 我和Makoto已经搞定了。她订的地方，我用信用卡付的钱。

lines.en: : We wound up getting two rooms but I hear the place is big, so we can probably all fit in one.
lines.zh: : 最后订了两间房，不过听说那地方很大，我们大概可以全挤在一间里。

lines.en: scene beachintro31
: The second room is just to be safe.
lines.zh: : 第二间只是以防万一。

lines.en: : Why are you winking?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在眨眼？

lines.en: scene beachintro32
: No reason, my precious best friend.
lines.zh: : 没什么理由，我珍贵的挚友。

lines.en: : I promise you that the second room will only be used if we’re all unable to cram ourselves together in the first one.
lines.zh: : 我保证，只有我们挤不进第一间的时候才会用第二间。

lines.en: : Or we could do the logical thing and have Sensei sleep in the second room.
lines.zh: : 或者我们可以做件合乎逻辑的事——让Sensei睡第二间。

lines.en: : I...agree with Maya...
lines.zh: : 我……同意Maya……

lines.en: : I’m not really comfortable sleeping in the same room as a boy...
lines.zh: : 我不太习惯和男生睡一个房间……

lines.en: scene beachintro31
: Don’t listen to them, Sensei. You can sleep in the bed with me.
lines.zh: : 别听她们的，Sensei。你可以和我睡一张床。

lines.en: : You mean the same bed Ami and I will also be sleeping in? Yeah, pass.
lines.zh: : 你是说我和Ami也要睡的那张床？谢了，免了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Maya can sleep on the floor and you can sleep between Ami and me.
lines.zh: : 那好办。Maya睡地板，你睡在我和Ami中间。

lines.en: scene beachintro33
: Well...I’d feel a little bad about Maya sleeping on the floor, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……让Maya睡地板我有点过意不去，不过……

lines.en: scene beachintro34
: You’re kidding, right?
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑的吧？

lines.en: scene beachintro35
: Or we could stick to the original plan and have you...not do that.
lines.zh: : 或者我们按原计划来，你……别那样。

lines.en: : I don’t mind sleeping in the other room with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不介意和Sensei睡另一间房。

lines.en: scene beachintro31
: There are two beds in there so it’s not like we’d be doing anything weird either.
lines.zh: : 里面有两张床，所以我们也做不了什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: : You’re winking again...
lines.zh: : 你又在眨眼了……

lines.en: : Sorry. It’s just a reflex at this point.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。这已经成条件反射了。

lines.en: scene sky
The five of us decide to get up and go shortly after that.
lines.zh: 之后不久，我们五个人决定起身出发。

lines.en: We walk to the bus stop together and all manage to fit in the same row of two seats.
lines.zh: 我们一起走到巴士站，全都挤进了同一排的两个座位。

lines.en: Ami forces Ayane away from me and takes a spot beside me while the other three sit across from us.
lines.zh: Ami把Ayane从我身边挤开，坐到我旁边，另外三个坐在我们对面。

lines.en: The bus ride to the beach takes about fifteen minutes.
lines.zh: 去海滩的巴士车程大概十五分钟。

lines.en: Ayane tells me that Makoto will take me to the cabin/resort/whatever the hell we’re staying at once we all meet up there.
lines.zh: Ayane告诉我，等大家到齐之后，Makoto会带我去小屋／度假村／管它叫什么的那个地方。

lines.en: So I guess for now it’s just...managing to survive the trip to the beach?
lines.zh: 所以现在嘛……就先想办法活着到海滩吧？

lines.en: scene black
Welcome to the first special update for Lessons in Love!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到《Lessons in Love》的第一个特别更新！

lines.en: Over the next two days, all events will play in succession.
lines.zh: 接下来的两天里，所有事件将连续播放。

lines.en: You will not have free time to do as you please, but you’ll still be able to raise your affection with everyone over the course of vacation.
lines.zh: 你不会有自由行动的时间，但在度假期间依然可以提升和所有人的好感度。

lines.en: So sit back, relax, and enjoy this mostly-wholesome beach adventure!
lines.zh: 所以放轻松，好好享受这段基本健康向上的海滩冒险吧！
